title: North Korea Launches Missiles Following US Military Drill Cuts
subtitle: Pyongyang rejects US efforts to scale back joint exercises as tensions remain high on the Korean Peninsula.

summary.en: North Korea fired approximately 10 short-range ballistic missiles into the sea on Thursday. This action occurred just one day after the United States and South Korea reduced the size of their annual military exercises. US President Donald Trump had ordered these cuts to improve relations with North Korean leader Kim Jong-un. However, Kim Yo-jong, the sister of the North Korean leader, dismissed the US gesture as insufficient. The situation remains tense as both sides continue to exchange messages about future diplomacy and military activities.
summary.zh: 北韓於週四向海域發射了約十枚短程彈道飛彈。此舉發生在美國與南韓縮減年度聯合軍演規模的隔天。美國總統川普曾下令縮減演習，以改善與北韓領導人金正恩的關係。然而，北韓領導人的胞妹金與正認為美國的姿態不足以展現誠意。隨著雙方持續就未來的外交與軍事活動交換訊息，局勢依然緊張。

paragraphs.en: North Korea launched about 10 short-range ballistic missiles toward the sea on Thursday, according to South Korea’s military. The launches took place from the Pyongyang area and were directed toward the country’s eastern waters. This significant military action happened only one day after North Korea rejected a US decision to scale back joint military exercises with South Korea.
paragraphs.zh: 根據南韓軍方消息，北韓於週四向海域發射了約十枚短程彈道飛彈。這些飛彈是從平壤地區發射，目標為該國東部海域。這項重大的軍事行動，發生在北韓拒絕美國縮減與南韓聯合軍事演習決定的隔天。

paragraphs.en: These missile tests are a direct challenge to international rules. South Korea’s presidential national security council held an emergency meeting following the event. In a statement, the council urged North Korea to stop these launches, which are banned under United Nations security council resolutions—official rules agreed upon by member countries to keep global peace. The Japanese prime minister’s office also confirmed that it had detected the suspected missile launches, showing the concern felt by neighboring countries.
paragraphs.zh: 這些飛彈試射是對國際規範的直接挑戰。南韓總統府國家安全會議在事件發生後召開了緊急會議。該委員會在聲明中敦促北韓停止此類發射行為，因為這些行為違反了聯合國安全理事會的決議，即成員國為維護全球和平所共同商定的正式規則。日本首相官邸也證實偵測到疑似飛彈發射，顯示出鄰國對此感到憂心。

paragraphs.en: Earlier this week, the United States and South Korea announced they were reducing their 11-day military exercises, known as the Ulchi Freedom Shield. US President Donald Trump had ordered the Pentagon to "substantially reduce" the exercises just before they began. According to The Guardian, President Trump explained that he made this decision because of his "good relationship" with North Korean leader Kim Jong-un. He also mentioned that South Korea had refused to support him in his ongoing war against Iran, which influenced his choice to change the military drills.
paragraphs.zh: 本週稍早，美國與南韓宣布縮減為期十一天的聯合軍演，該演習稱為「乙支自由之盾 (Ulchi Freedom Shield)」。美國總統川普 (Donald Trump) 在演習開始前，曾下令五角大廈「大幅縮減」演習規模。根據《衛報 (The Guardian)》報導，川普總統解釋他做出此決定，是因為他與北韓領導人金正恩之間有著「良好的關係」。他也提到，南韓拒絕支持他目前針對伊朗的行動，這也影響了他改變軍事演習的決定。

paragraphs.en: Despite the reduction in the size and length of the drills, North Korea’s reaction was not positive. Kim Yo-jong, the influential sister of the North Korean leader, dismissed the US move. She stated that the "provocative, aggressive nature" of the drills would not change, even if they were smaller. According to NPR, she warned that if the US thinks it can call this move a sign of "good faith"—meaning honest and sincere intentions—it will not get the answer it wants from Pyongyang.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管演習的規模與長度均有所縮減，北韓的反應卻並不正面。北韓領導人極具影響力的胞妹金與正，對美國此舉不以為然。她表示，即便演習規模縮小，其「挑釁且具侵略性的本質」並不會改變。根據美國國家公共廣播電台 (NPR) 報導，她警告說，如果美國認為可以將此舉稱為展現「善意」（意指誠實且真誠的意圖），那麼美國將無法從平壤那裡得到想要的答案。

paragraphs.en: Kim Yo-jong also pointed to other military activities as reasons for North Korea's frustration. She highlighted a series of earlier drills carried out by the US and South Korea this year, as well as South Korea’s plan to introduce nuclear-powered submarines. However, she did not use the very angry language that North Korea sometimes uses. She noted that the personal relationship between her brother and President Trump was "still excellent." This suggests that North Korea might be waiting for the US to offer bigger rewards or changes before they agree to return to official talks.
paragraphs.zh: 金與正也指出其他軍事活動是導致北韓不滿的原因。她強調了美韓今年稍早進行的一系列演習，以及南韓引進核動力潛艦的計畫。不過，她並未使用北韓有時會採用的激烈言詞。她提到，她哥哥與川普總統之間的私人關係「依然極佳」。這暗示北韓可能正在等待美國提供更大的回報或做出改變，才會同意重返正式談判。

paragraphs.en: President Trump remains optimistic about future meetings. On Wednesday, when reporters asked if he would meet with Kim Jong-un this year, the US president replied, "Yeah, I will be." While he did not say if they were currently exchanging letters, he insisted that he gets along well with the North Korean leader. This is a sharp contrast to the view from Pyongyang, where officials have denied Trump’s claim that Kim Jong-un responded to his request for a conversation.
paragraphs.zh: 川普總統對未來的會晤仍保持樂觀。週三當記者詢問他今年是否會與金正恩會面時，這位美國總統回答：「會的，我會。」雖然他未透露雙方目前是否正在交換信件，但他堅持自己與北韓領導人相處融洽。這與平壤方面的觀點形成強烈對比，平壤官員否認了川普關於金正恩已回應其對話請求的說法。

paragraphs.en: North Korea has long described US-South Korea joint exercises as "invasion rehearsals," or practice for an attack. As reported by Deutsche Welle, the country often responds to these exercises by firing missiles. President Trump has called the war games "inappropriate and hostile," noting that they are expensive and send the wrong message to a country that he claims has been respectful toward him.
paragraphs.zh: 北韓長期以來將美韓聯合軍演描述為「入侵預演」，即攻擊演練。據德國之聲 (Deutsche Welle) 報導，該國經常以發射飛彈作為對這些演習的回應。川普總統曾稱這些戰爭遊戲「不恰當且具敵意」，並指出這些演習既昂貴，又對一個他聲稱對他保持尊重的國家傳遞了錯誤的訊息。

paragraphs.en: As the military exercises come to an end this Friday, the situation remains complicated. South Korea is currently working to improve its own military independence, a goal that has become more urgent following the recent changes to the US drills. While the US hopes that reducing military pressure will lead to a breakthrough in diplomacy, North Korea’s latest actions show that the path to peace is still very difficult. Both sides are now in a waiting game, with the world watching to see if the promised meeting between the two leaders will actually happen later this year.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著軍事演習於本週五結束，局勢依然複雜。南韓目前正致力於提升自身的軍事獨立性，在美軍演習近期發生變動後，這項目標變得更加迫切。雖然美國希望降低軍事壓力能促成外交上的突破，但北韓的最新行動顯示，通往和平的道路依然困難重重。雙方目前都在進行一場等待遊戲，全世界都在關注兩位領導人承諾的會晤是否真的會在今年稍晚實現。

keyTerms.definitionEn: To reduce the size, amount, or extent of something.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見於商業或軍事語境，指縮減規模。文中：North Korea rejected a US decision to scale back joint military exercises with South Korea.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To decide that something is not important enough to consider or take seriously.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 不予理會、認為不重要、駁回。
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作「解僱」，這裡指對某事不屑一顧。文中：Kim Yo-jong, the influential sister of the North Korean leader, dismissed the US move.

keyTerms.definitionEn: A situation where you delay taking action until a better opportunity arises.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 等待時機的策略、觀望狀態。
keyTerms.noteZh: 指雙方都在等待對方先行動。文中：Both sides are now in a waiting game, with the world watching to see if the promised meeting between the two leaders will actually happen later this year.

quiz.question: According to the article, what reason did President Trump provide for his decision to reduce the military exercises?

options.A: He wanted to comply with United Nations security council resolutions.
options.B: He cited his positive relationship with Kim Jong-un and his frustration with South Korea's lack of support regarding Iran.
options.C: He believed the exercises were a waste of money and were not effective at deterring North Korean aggression.
options.D: He was responding to direct pressure from Kim Yo-jong to stop the 'aggressive' drills.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第三段，川普總統明確提到減少軍演的原因有二：一是他與金正恩的「良好關係」，二是南韓未在對伊朗的戰爭中支持他。選項 A 錯誤，因為聯合國決議是南韓國家安全會議引用的，而非川普的理由。選項 C 雖在第七段提到軍演昂貴，但並非他決定縮減的主要動機。選項 D 錯誤，因為金 Yo-jong 的回應是在縮減計畫宣布後才發生的，並非川普決策的依據。

quiz.question: Based on the text, what can be inferred about North Korea's attitude toward the United States?

options.A: They have completely cut off all diplomatic communication with the US.
options.B: They are willing to end all missile testing if the US stops the 'Ulchi Freedom Shield' drills.
options.C: They maintain a complex stance, balancing public criticism of US military actions with a desire to keep personal diplomatic channels open.
options.D: They have lost all respect for President Trump and no longer care about his personal relationship with their leader.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。從第四段與第五段可以看出，雖然金 Yo-jong 批評軍演具有「挑釁與侵略性」，但她同時也強調與川普的個人關係「依然極佳」。這顯示北韓並非全面斷絕關係，而是在採取一種策略性的雙重態度，一方面抗議軍事行動，一方面保留談判的空間。選項 A 不正確，因為文中提到他們仍在等待更好的條件。選項 B 無法從文中證實，因為北韓對縮減軍演仍不滿意。選項 D 與文中提到的「關係依然極佳」矛盾。

quiz.question: In the fourth paragraph, what does the word 'dismissed' mean as used in the context of Kim Yo-jong's reaction?

options.A: To reject or treat something as unworthy of serious consideration.
options.B: To officially fire someone from a government position.
options.C: To physically remove something from a specific location.
options.D: To change one's mind after careful deliberation.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在第四段中，Kim Yo-jong 對美國縮減軍演的舉動表示「dismissed」，意指她認為此舉不足以改變軍演的本質，因此不予重視或否定其價值。選項 B 指的是解僱人員，不符合文意。選項 C 指的是物理上的移除，與此處描述的態度或觀點不符。選項 D 則與「dismiss」的原意相反，dismiss 通常代表拒絕採納或認為不重要，而非經過深思熟慮後的改變心意。

quiz.question: What is the central message of the article regarding the current state of US-North Korea relations?

options.A: The reduction of military exercises has successfully led to a peaceful breakthrough in diplomatic relations.
options.B: North Korea has agreed to stop all missile tests in exchange for the US ending its 'invasion rehearsals'.
options.C: The relationship is currently defined by a stalemate, where diplomatic optimism from the US clashes with North Korea's military provocations.
options.D: South Korea has taken the lead in negotiations, effectively replacing the US as the primary mediator with North Korea.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。文章整體描述了美國對未來的樂觀態度與北韓持續進行飛彈試射及批評軍演之間的矛盾。最後一段總結道，儘管美國希望透過減少壓力達成外交突破，但北韓的行動顯示和平之路依然困難，雙方處於一種「等待遊戲」的僵局。選項 A 過於樂觀且與事實不符。選項 B 錯誤，因為北韓並未停止試射。選項 D 雖然提到南韓在改善軍事獨立性，但並未說其已取代美國成為主要調解人。
